sources.title: podolinsky/groot-libero-x-probe-lstm-onset-post-mode · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: lstm_onset_post_mode (GR00T-N1.7 / LIBERO-X level123, task split) Causal LSTM (256) failure probe with a score head, a failure-mode head (10 classes) and a CLIP-aligned semantic head (64-d, InfoNCE against the PCA-64 CLIP embedding of the timeline phrase). Trained on onset_post labels: all steps kept, label 1 from 2.4 s before the Gemini onset to the end of a failed rollout.

sources.title: GR00T-N1.7 LIBERO-10 backbone features - claru.ai
sources.snippet: Aligned rollouts of the NVIDIA GR00T-N1.7-LIBERO policy on LIBERO tasks in normal and occluded variants, with K=10 action samples per inference and per-token backbone features from the Cosmos-Reason2-2B VLM backbone. Designed for representation probing and sampling-based failure detection research.

sources.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
sources.snippet: A robot foundation model, trained on massive and diverse data sources, is essential for enabling the robots to reason about novel situations, robustly handle real-world variability, and rapidly learn new tasks. To this end, we introduce GR00T N1, an open foundation model for humanoid robots.
